james_sacristan.text: Welcome to St James'. Behind the town rises Mount Brandon, nearly a thousand metres, named after Saint Brendan the Navigator.
Brendan was a monk who, the old story goes, sailed west in a leather boat. In 1976 Tim Severin built a copy and sailed from Kerry to Newfoundland.
It worked, which surprised everyone, including the cows who donated the leather. The pilgrim path up the mountain is Cosán na Naomh.
